title: Hindi 1
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText:
This course is intended for those learning Hindi from scratch or as heritage students. You cannot enrol in this course if you are a native or near-native speaker of Hindi (eg international student from India).
Students with previous experience of the language must sit a language proficiency assessment.
Students cannot enrol in this course if they have already completed HIND1100, HIND1200, HIND2300, HIND2400, HIND3500 or HIND3600.
